questions.question: Describe your hands-on experience with C or C++. What types of software have you built or maintained, and which language features or practices do you use to keep the code reliable?
This role involves improving and optimizing a rendering engine. How would you approach investigating a rendering-performance problem, such as inconsistent frame times or excessive CPU usage?

Your iOS work included UIKit and SpriteKit animations. Can you describe an animation or graphics-related feature you implemented, including the technical challenges and how you validated the user experience?
When joining an unfamiliar, mature C++ codebase, how do you build an understanding of its architecture, ownership model, build system, and key execution paths before making changes?
Give an example from your experience where you diagnosed and fixed a difficult defect. How did you reproduce it, identify the root cause, and ensure the fix did not introduce regressions?
You mention unit testing and code-quality improvement at Vertiv. What testing practices have you used, and how would you test a low-level C++ graphics or UI-framework feature?
In your iOS applications, how did you manage memory, object ownership, and resource lifecycles in Objective-C or Swift? How would those considerations translate to native C++ development?

Describe your experience collaborating with UI/UX designers and other engineers during the LifeFuels or task-manager application projects. How did you turn a design requirement into an implemented and testable feature?

Suppose a customer reports that a complex UI works correctly on one graphics device but renders incorrectly or performs poorly on another. What information would you gather, and how would you structure the investigation?
You have worked across Java, JavaScript, Objective-C, Swift, and C/C++. How do you learn a new technology or framework quickly while still delivering maintainable production code?
